pages.title: Terms of Service
pages.body:
## Overview
These terms apply to every purchase and visit on {{name}}. By using this website or buying a product you agree to them.

## Digital products
- All products are digital (download or online access). Nothing is shipped.
- Access is provided after your payment is confirmed.
- Products are for your personal or business use. Reselling, sharing or redistributing them is not allowed.

## Refunds
Because digital products can be copied once delivered, payments are generally non-refundable. If a file is corrupted or you did not receive access, contact us and we will fix it.

## Pricing
Prices are in Indian Rupees (₹) and may change without notice.

## Changes
We may update these terms at any time. Continued use of the website means you accept the updated terms.

## Contact
Questions? Please visit our Contact Us page.

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.body:
## Information we collect
When you place an order we collect your email address and phone number so we can deliver your product and contact you about it. We do not store card or UPI details - payments are handled by our payment provider.

## How we use it
- To deliver purchased products and send order updates
- To answer support requests
- To improve our website

## Sharing
We never sell your personal data. We share it only with the payment provider and partners needed to complete your order, or when the law requires it.

## Cookies and storage
This website uses your browser storage to remember basic preferences and to count anonymous visits.

## Your choices
Write to {{email}} to ask us to access or delete your data.

## Changes
We may update this policy from time to time.
